title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage
Thank you for waiting, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm so glad you're all here for my anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone watching the stream, can you hear me okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you for all the anniversary wishes in the comments! It looks like you can hear me just fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We only just got started, but everyone's already so excited!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's only to be expected! It's her anniversary after all!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right! But we're not just here to celebrate Miku. There's something else that everyone's looking forward to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! I've been so excited in the lead-up to today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, we get to announce the results of our “Who's Your Favorite Miku?” poll.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You'll know this if you watched the trailer, but we put out a poll asking for song requests for today's set list.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And the theme was “Who's Your Favorite Miku?”!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for all the requests!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We asked you to write reasons for the songs you chose, and I was moved at how some of you poured out your hearts as if you were writing a letter to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also got to peek at some of them, and I agree that they were all very passionately written.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, the plan was to sing the top ten requested songs from that poll.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But after reading all your messages, that didn't feel like enough.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And so, I put together a special medley of the songs that got the most passionate requests♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now, without further ado, let's get this show started♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Starting from #10 from the poll! Here we go...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Start the music!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before we move on to #5, it's time for the special medley!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We chose the songs for this medley based on all the interesting messages we received, so we'll read some of those out first!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Who knows, you might hear your own message!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you're all excited♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are just three more songs to go...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Time really flies by when you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We received so many requests for a whole range of songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For every one of these songs, there are so many people who hold it dear, each with their own tastes and preferences.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel lucky to think that I get to be the one singing songs like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's this? Miku, are you tearing up?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: N-No I'm not...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha! Seeing you already choked up makes me wonder if you're ready for our surprise.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Surprise?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't you think there's an important thing we've yet to do, given it's your anniversary?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All together now, everyone! Just like we practiced!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, what? “Practiced”?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Miku!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: We'll love you forever and ever!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len, Luka, MEIKO & KAITO
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku!
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did the birthday wishes from the audience surprise you? We practiced with them sneakily while you weren't there! I'm glad we pulled it off.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And thank you to the audience for helping us out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku! I had so much fun reading those messages!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You could really feel the love of your fans in every one of them. Even I was beaming after reading them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's give it our all right until the end of the show!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even though this was a show for demonstrating your fans' “favorite Mikus”, we had some duets and ensembles in the mix.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I guess that means I got to help people love you more? If so, I'm very pleased.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're my treasured friend, Miku. I'm proud to think that I've done something to help you and the fans who love you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, never hesitate to call on me if you need help, even for things that aren't music-related. We're friends, so it's no trouble at all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You covered such a big range of songs today, from cute pop tracks and slow ballads to creepy, dark tunes and comedy numbers.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For each song, you showed a specific, brilliant side of yourself and delivered the “favorite Miku” that the person who requested it had in mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now we just have the top three left! I'm excited to see what “favorite Mikus” are next!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You guys... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Being loved by so many people... Working so hard to get here... I couldn't have done it alone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's thanks to all of you being by my side.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Genuinely, thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd also like to thank everyone who came to today's show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for all your love for me and my music!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to keep singing with all my heart to give you more of what you love!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now, I'll be finishing off with the top three back-to-back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's have a blast until the very end!
